Fetches and parses Amazon Linux Security Advisory (ALAS) update information from Amazon's mirror infrastructure for versions 1, 2, 2022, and 2023.

## Key Components

| Symbol | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `FetchFiles` | func | Entry point; fetches update info for one or more Amazon Linux versions, returning a map of version → `models.Updates` |
| `fetchUpdateInfoAmazonLinux` | func | Resolves a mirror list URL to actual update data by iterating available mirrors |
| `fetchUpdateInfoURL` | func | Fetches `repomd.xml` from each mirror and extracts the `updateinfo` data URL |
| `fetchUpdateInfo` | func | Downloads, decompresses (gzip), and XML-decodes the final updateinfo file, extracting CVE IDs |
| `mirrors` | var | Hardcoded map of Amazon Linux version → mirror URL(s) for core, extras, and livepatch repositories |
| `errNoUpdateInfo` | var | Sentinel error returned when no `updateinfo` field is found in `repomd.xml` |

## Usage Example

```go
// Fetch update info for Amazon Linux 2 and 2023
updates, err := amazon.FetchFiles([]string{"2", "2023"})
if err != nil {
    log.Fatal(err)
}

for version, u := range updates {
    fmt.Printf("Amazon Linux %s: %d advisories\n", version, len(u.UpdateList))
    for _, alas := range u.UpdateList {
        fmt.Printf("  %s CVEs: %v\n", alas.UpdateID, alas.CVEIDs)
    }
}
```

## Version-Specific Behavior

| Version | Behavior |
|---------|----------|
| `1`, `2022` | Fetches core mirror only |
| `2` | Fetches core mirror + iterates all extras topics from `extras-catalog.json`, tagging each with `amzn2extra-<topic>` |
| `2023` | Fetches core mirror + kernel livepatch mirror, tagging livepatch entries with `kernel-livepatch` |
